description: Every safely or unsafely fixable manifest and workspace issue: a public root, a version mismatch, an unsorted section, a local path to a workspace package, an empty section and a stray lockfile.

yarn.reason: Yarn Berry rewrites the manifests on install: it drops empty sections and sorts the dependency sections.

yarn-classic.reason: Yarn Classic refuses to install the workspaces of a root that is not private, so the overlay makes it private.
